_comment: Prices for the market stage. Tuning the economy means editing this file, not GDScript - same rule crops.json follows. Seed cost is per plant sown; price_per_kg is what a Grade A kilogram fetches, and crops.json's grade_b_price_multiplier scales a Grade B one down from there.
_supplies_comment: Consumables the market sells alongside seed. Sprays are what makes Stage 3's pest control a decision rather than a free click - an untreated outbreak costs yield, but a wasted spray costs money.

spray.description: Clears one pest outbreak. Consumed on use.

fertiliser.description: Applied as you sow. The crop develops faster and starts with better soil moisture.

_fertiliser_comment: What one bag of fertiliser buys, applied to a single plant at sowing.
_produce_comment: Things the farm produces that are not simulated crops. Keys are the collectable_name values the pickup scenes already use, which are lowercase - the inventory is keyed by those, not by display names.
